name: flaggems_special_shifted_chebyshev_polynomial_w
description: Shifted Chebyshev polynomial of the fourth kind W_n(x), evaluated elementwise via torch.special.shifted_chebyshev_polynomial_w. Correctness: x is random float32 and n is a custom int32 tensor with values in [0,10]; the reference upcasts both operands to float64 and casts the result back to float32, mirroring the pytest to_reference(..., upcast=True) oracle. Timing reproduces BinaryPointwiseBenchmark with both x and n as random float32 tensors. Source pytest/benchmark is NVIDIA-only; this KernelGen baseline verifies the target vendor PyTorch reference only and does not establish FlagGems candidate support on PPU.
